        },
        [6100708] = {
          ContentEN = [[

        [6100801] = {

        [6100908] = {

          ContentEN = "You try to recall the stones she cherished. Though their origin eludes you, you sense that fire magic could shape something akin to them.
Using the campfire as a focus, you gather your power, channelling it through its heat...
In an instant, golden fragments fall like meteors from above — ringing softly as they strike the earth, each note bright as a bell.",
          DialogueId = 6102405,
          GUID = "0F46D7D2",
          NextDialogue = 6102406,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102406] = {
          ContentEN = ""Ah...! My stones — these are my stones! Thank you, messenger of the gods!"
She scoops them up one by one, cradling them in the fold of her skirt like treasures beyond price.",
          DialogueId = 6102406,
          GUID = "0F46D7FC",
          NextDialogue = 6102407,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room323_Char01"
        },
        [6102407] = {
          ContentEN = "They match the crystals you once glimpsed in her arms. You cannot help but wonder: were they always there — fragments left behind in some forgotten journey of your own?
Either way, the girl has reclaimed her "certainty"... And you, too, must walk on.",
          DialogueId = 6102407,
          GUID = "0F46D826",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102408] = {
          ContentEN = "Tell her that life doesn't always go the way we hope.",
          DialogueId = 6102408,
          GUID = "0F46D850",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102409,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102409] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"I know... I know."
"That's why I've given up... I no longer read the books, nor ponder the origin of magic, nor ask what lies within that tower..." 
"All I want now is a scrap of firelight.. Is even that too much to ask?"]],
          DialogueId = 6102409,
          GUID = "0F46D87A",
          NextDialogue = 6102410,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room323_Char01"
        },
        [6102410] = {
          ContentEN = [[
You are left speechless. 
Suddenly, the girl rises to her feet. Before you can react, she steps resolutely into the fire.
Her form melts slowly into the blaze, until not a trace remains.
You turn away... and press on.]],
          DialogueId = 6102410,
          GUID = "0F46D8A4",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102501] = {
          ContentEN = "The campfire burns quietly. This time, no Phantasms stir within its glow. 
As you turn to leave, something catches your eye —
Scattered across the soil at your feet, tiny golden stones gleam like stars fallen from the heavens.",
          DialogueId = 6102501,
          GUID = "0F46E792",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102502,
            [2] = 6102506
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102502] = {
          ContentEN = "Pick up the stones and cast them into the fire.",
          DialogueId = 6102502,
          GUID = "0F46E7BC",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102503,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102503] = {
          ContentEN = "The flames leap higher — then stretch unnaturally to either side.
You step back, wary. Suddenly, a figure takes shape within the blaze... And you see that the light streaming outward is not flame at all, but strands of a girl's hair.",
          DialogueId = 6102503,
          GUID = "0F46E7E6",
          NextDialogue = 6102504,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102504] = {
          ContentEN = ""Hello! You found my stones, didn't you?"
The girl leaps from the fire, tossing her head as golden pebbles tumble from her hair with a bright, crackling chime.
"Now I need never search again — see? So long as I step into the fire, I can make the stones myself!"",
          DialogueId = 6102504,
          GUID = "0F46E810",
          NextDialogue = 6102505,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room324_Char01"
        },
        [6102505] = {
          ContentEN = ""Forgive me, I've no time for chitchat — I'm still far from collecting all one hundred and forty-six."
"But I found something that may aid you. Please, take it — and may your journey be swift and safe!"
She presses something into your hand, then vanishes once more into the flames.",
          DialogueId = 6102505,
          GUID = "0F46E83A",
          NextDialogue = 6102510,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room324_Char01"
        },
        [6102506] = {
          ContentEN = "Observe quietly.",
          DialogueId = 6102506,
          GUID = "0F46E864",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102507,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102507] = {
          ContentEN = "The fire burns on, steady and soft. For a moment, you fancy you hear a voice within the flames.",
          DialogueId = 6102507,
          GUID = "0F46E88E",
          NextDialogue = 6102508,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102508] = {
          ContentEN = ""Yes... yes. I'll keep it in mind."
The girl's gentle, contented voice drifts from the fire.
"Questions must know their limits. Flame is the gift of the gods, not merely matter reacting to heat. Just like these stones — treasures bestowed upon me, that I might sleep in peace...",
          DialogueId = 6102508,
          GUID = "0F46E8B8",
          NextDialogue = 6102509,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room324_Char01"
        },
        [6102509] = {
          ContentEN = "You turn away in silence. A stone rolls to the path before you. You step forward — and inadvertently crush it beneath your boot.
The treasure of the gods... so fragile, after all.",
          DialogueId = 6102509,
          GUID = "0F46E8E2",
          NextDialogue = 6102510,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102510] = {
          ContentEN = "And you wonder — was that flame a "certainty" that granted her peace... or a "shackle" that bound her still? 
Perhaps the two were never different at all.",
          DialogueId = 6102510,
          GUID = "0F46E90C",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102601] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Forgive me... it's all my fault... I'm too stupid to remember the hymns... Too lazy to sit through the sermons..."
"O divine ones, please forgive me..."]],
          DialogueId = 6102601,
          GUID = "0F46F7FA",
          NextDialogue = 6102602,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room325_Char01"
        },
        [6102602] = {
          ContentEN = "The girl murmurs her confession as though no one's watching — or perhaps, she no longer sees anyone at all.
She looks worse than last time; even her eyes have lost their light.",
          DialogueId = 6102602,
          GUID = "0F46F824",
          NextDialogue = 6102603,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102603] = {
          ContentEN = ""You are... the traveller... Has it been so long already?" 
At last, she notices you — turning her head with weary slowness. 
"Traveller... tell me... why is it that though I pray day and night, the gods never answer?"",
          DialogueId = 6102603,
          GUID = "0F46F84E",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102604,
            [2] = 6102608
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room325_Char01"
        },
        [6102604] = {
          ContentEN = "Encourage her to continue her prayers.",
          DialogueId = 6102604,
          GUID = "0F46F878",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102605,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102605] = {
          ContentEN = "It was not yet time to change her fate. So you let the lie endure — for even falsehood may serve as a form of hope.
You tell her that if she continues to pray, then salvation will come one day.
And it is not wholly untrue. You believe the Abyss may yet be overcome. It's just that her prayers do not matter. The truth lies not in ritual — but in the Lantern you bear.",
          DialogueId = 6102605,
          GUID = "0F46F8A2",
          NextDialogue = 6102606,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102606] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"I see... I believe you." 
She clasps her hands and resumes her prayers, her voice steadier than before.]],
          DialogueId = 6102606,
          GUID = "0F46F8CC",
          NextDialogue = 6102607,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room325_Char01"
        },
        [6102607] = {
          ContentEN = "With a quiet sigh, you tighten your grip on the Lantern — and press onward.",
          DialogueId = 6102607,
          GUID = "0F46F8F6",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102608] = {
          ContentEN = "Tell her the gods will not answer.",
          DialogueId = 6102608,
          GUID = "0F46F920",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102609,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102609] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"The gods... will never answer me?" 
"Is it because my sins are too deep... that I am no longer worthy of salvation?" 
She looks at you in despair, tears slipping down cheeks already pocked with sores.]],
          DialogueId = 6102609,
          GUID = "0F46F94A",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102610
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room325_Char01"
        },
        [6102610] = {
          ContentEN = "It is because you never bore any sin.",
          DialogueId = 6102610,
          GUID = "0F46F974",
          NextDialogue = 6102611,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102611] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Huh...?" 
The girl freezes, her eyes wide with confusion.]],
          DialogueId = 6102611,
          GUID = "0F46F99E",
          NextDialogue = 6102612,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room325_Char01"
        },
        [6102612] = {
          ContentEN = "You give her a steady smile and make her a promise: that you will find a way to end her suffering.
She stares at you, half comprehending... and gives a faint nod. Then you notice — her wounds have ceased to bleed.
With a final wave, you tighten your grip on the Lantern, and press onward.",
          DialogueId = 6102612,
          GUID = "0F46F9C8",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102701] = {
          ContentEN = "Fusa, Goddess of the Full Moon—"
"Mistress of radiant paths, Weaver of destiny's threads..."
"By the dome and the moonlight as witness, we lift our hymn of devotion unto You...",
          DialogueId = 6102701,
          GUID = "0F470862",
          NextDialogue = 6102702,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room326_Char01"
        },
        [6102702] = {
          ContentEN = "Figures rise within the fire, their voices joined in solemn prayer.",
          DialogueId = 6102702,
          GUID = "0F47088C",
          NextDialogue = 6102703,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102703] = {
          ContentEN = "Who are you? A traveller astray?" 
One worshipper turns towards you, smiling gently as she reaches out her hand. 
"Come — join us in prayer to the Goddess of the Full Moon. Surely She will bless the path before you.",
          DialogueId = 6102703,
          GUID = "0F4708B6",
          NextDialogue = 6102704,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room326_Char01"
        },
        [6102704] = {
          ContentEN = "They raise their hymn to <H>Fusa</>, Goddess of Fate — <H>ninth among the Great Nine</>.
She who reigns over the full moon, and draws down its silvery light to weave the threads of fate.",
          DialogueId = 6102704,
          GUID = "0F4708E0",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102705,
            [2] = 6102709
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102705] = {
          ContentEN = "Join their prayer.",
          DialogueId = 6102705,
          GUID = "0F47090A",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102706,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102706] = {
          ContentEN = "This was the kind of gathering you once despised as a child — hollow praises, memorised and soon forgotten. Yet now, a faint nostalgia stirs within you.
You bow your head and join them in prayer.",
          DialogueId = 6102706,
          GUID = "0F470934",
          NextDialogue = 6102707,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102707] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Fusa, Goddess of the Full Moon, ever constant across the heavens, amidst fate's turning."
"To You we give honour. Bless Your faithful..."
"And grant us flawless fortune and joy."]],
          DialogueId = 6102707,
          GUID = "0F47095E",
          NextDialogue = 6102708,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102708] = {
          ContentEN = [[
Eyes closed, you echo the devotion of the faithful.
And when you open them again, the figures are gone.]],
          DialogueId = 6102708,
          GUID = "0F470988",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102709] = {
          ContentEN = "Refuse to join their prayer.",
          DialogueId = 6102709,
          GUID = "0F4709B2",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102710,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102710] = {
          ContentEN = "Refuse? You—why!?" 
The worshipper's voice sharpens with disbelief.
"Heretic! Are you of the Noclunism? A follower of Nepha!?",
          DialogueId = 6102710,
          GUID = "0F4709DC",
          NextDialogue = 6102711,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room326_Char01"
        },
        [6102711] = {
          ContentEN = "At that forbidden name, all eyes turn. Their faces twist — the warmth gone, replaced by grotesque hatred.
You sigh. There's no avoiding it now — you'll have to break free from their encircling ranks.",
          DialogueId = 6102711,
          GUID = "0F470A06",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102801] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Shears of fate's thread, Mistress of eternal stillness..."
"By the Abyss and the long night as witness, hear my humble prayer..."]],
          DialogueId = 6102801,
          GUID = "0F4718CA",
          NextDialogue = 6102802,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room327_Char01"
        },
        [6102802] = {
          ContentEN = [[
Figures rise once more within the fire, their voices joined in solemn chant.
You listen in silence. The words are unfamiliar to you.]],
          DialogueId = 6102802,
          GUID = "0F4718F4",
          NextDialogue = 6102803,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102803] = {
          ContentEN = "Who are you? A traveller astray?" 
One worshipper turns towards you, smiling gently as she reaches out her hand. 
"Or have you too glimpsed the hidden truth — and come seeking the embrace of the true saviour, Nepha?",
          DialogueId = 6102803,
          GUID = "0F47191E",
          NextDialogue = 6102804,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room327_Char01"
        },
        [6102804] = {
          ContentEN = "<H>Nepha</>... you remember the name. 
Rarely mentioned in the Orthodox texts of Elysium... you have seen it only in dust-laden scrolls, half-effaced by time. A forbidden name — the long forgotten <H>tenth deity</>.",
          DialogueId = 6102804,
          GUID = "0F471948",
          NextDialogue = 6102805,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102805] = {
          ContentEN = "She was the Goddess of the Dark Moon and of Death. Sister to Fusa.
While her elder sister weaves the threads of fate, Nepha severs them.
Their endless struggle gave rise to the waxing and waning of the moon, and stirred the tides.
If these people are Her followers, then they must be—",
          DialogueId = 6102805,
          GUID = "0F471972",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102806
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102806] = {
          ContentEN = "Ask about their faith.",
          DialogueId = 6102806,
          GUID = "0F47199C",
          NextDialogue = 6102807,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102807] = {
          ContentEN = "Since you stand here, you must already know — the Abyss is not a lifeless pit. It is alive. Ever growing. Ever spreading."
"The golden holy sword of the knights cannot hold back its dark tide. The light of the Full Moon cannot pierce the abysmal quiet."
"As every light races towards its extinguishing, so too must all living things meet their end. The only certainty... is perishing. The Abyss is the world's true form."
"Welcome, dear traveller — to the <H>Noclunism</>.",
          DialogueId = 6102807,
          GUID = "0F4719C6",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102808,
            [2] = 6102811
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room327_Char02"
        },
        [6102808] = {
          ContentEN = "Accept their invitation.",
          DialogueId = 6102808,
          GUID = "0F4719F0",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102809,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102809] = {
          ContentEN = "Even if they were only phantoms, you wish not to provoke them needlessly.
So, with a solemn expression and well-practised tone, you begin to recite the tenets of the Noclunism — fragments once heard and half-remembered: "The deathward instinct"... "Nepha's salvation"... "The Abyss is eternity itself"... 
Their faces soften. They nod again and again, pleased by your borrowed eloquence.",
          DialogueId = 6102809,
          GUID = "0F471A1A",
          NextDialogue = 6102810,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102810] = {
          ContentEN = "Your great learning humbles us, your wisdom humbles us. Please — accept these gifts, friend!" 
You bluff your way through. Perhaps... not every sermon of your youth is wasted on wandering thoughts.",
          DialogueId = 6102810,
          GUID = "0F471A44",
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room327_Char02"
        },
        [6102811] = {
          ContentEN = "Refuse their invitation.",
          DialogueId = 6102811,
          GUID = "0F471A6E",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6102812,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102812] = {
          ContentEN = "Along this weary road, you too have pondered often —
the meaning of life, the meaning of death. At times, you've believed that death might be the only release.
But <H>those few chance encounters</>... They've rekindled your reason to keep walking — through the dark, and through the doubt. Now, your resolve burns like a flame:
You will drive back the dark, even if it means burning your own body as kindling. Even if your light endures for only a moment — you will blaze against this stagnant eternity.",
          DialogueId = 6102812,
          GUID = "0F471A98",
          NextDialogue = 6102813,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102813] = {
          ContentEN = "The Abyss is not Eternity. You are but echoes — phantoms of lives once lived."
You raise your weapon. 
"Back to where you belong, souls of the departed—",
          DialogueId = 6102813,
          GUID = "0F471AC2",
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102901] = {
          ContentEN = "You settle beside the campfire for a rest.
Suddenly, a faint sound tickles your ear... then rises, drifting somewhere above.
It swells — a soft, feathery rustle, like velvet wings brushing together.",
          DialogueId = 6102901,
          GUID = "0F472932",
          NextDialogue = 6102902,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102902] = {
          ContentEN = "Hey there! Lucky traveller!",
          DialogueId = 6102902,
          GUID = "0F47295C",
          NextDialogue = 6102903,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room381_Char01"
        },
        [6102903] = {
          ContentEN = "A flurry of vibrant feathers rains down from above — more colours than you've ever seen in the Abyssum.
You find yourself knee-deep in absurd fluff, like the butt of a street prank caught between comedy and pity.",
          DialogueId = 6102903,
          GUID = "0F472986",
          NextDialogue = 6102904,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6102904] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Hello? Aren't you going to react? How long have you been down here? Isn't it dull yet?"
A figure descends upside-down, eyes level with yours. He wears a comical bird mask, the beak swaying dangerously close to your nose.
How he's holding that pose, you can't begin to guess.]],
          DialogueId = 6102904,
          GUID = "0F4729B0",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102905
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room381_Char01"
        },
        [6102905] = {
          ContentEN = "I don't have time for this.",
          DialogueId = 6102905,
          GUID = "0F4729DA",
          NextDialogue = 6102906,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6102906] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Aw, don't be so frosty. Didn't those Elysian fogeys ever tell you? A good deed a day keeps bad luck away!"
"Come on, <H>play a little game</> with me. Win, and I'll give you a prize. Lose? No punishment. Nothing's at stake here. What do you say?"]],
          DialogueId = 6102906,
          GUID = "0F472A04",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6102907
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room381_Char01"
        },
        [6102907] = {
          ContentEN = "Alright then.",
          DialogueId = 6102907,
          GUID = "0F472A2E",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6103001] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"O let us raise a hymn to <H>Shaliel</>!" 
"He, the hallowed Saint of Elysium..."
"Who hearkened to Fusa's revelation, and taught mankind mercy, forgiveness, and love."
"Upon the crimson soil of Elysium, peace once more put forth its tender shoots."]],
          DialogueId = 6103001,
          GUID = "0F47399A",
          NextDialogue = 6103002,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcId = 910005,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_Room328_Char01"
        },
        [6103002] = {
          ContentEN = "An old man stands near the broken wall, garbed in a bard's robe. One hand brushes its weathered surface as he sings.
Though fractured, the wall is well preserved. And in the Lantern's faint glow, a mural emerges — a towering image of the very <H>Shaliel</> the bard exalts.
Shaliel — saint of two millennia past, one of the first <H>Seven Virtues</>: Temperance.
The bard sings on, unaware of your presence.",
          DialogueId = 6103002,
          GUID = "0F4739C4",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6103003
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6103003] = {
          ContentEN = "Keep listening.",
          DialogueId = 6103003,
          GUID = "0F4739EE",
          NextDialogue = 6103004,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6103004] = {
          ContentEN = "Yet the Saint's heart was ever troubled:"
"by Fusa's promise to mankind — the Heaven above Heavens."
"At last, after seventy-seven days of stillness beside the azure lake,"
"beneath the full moon, he beheld the truth... and in its waters, he touched Eternity.",
          DialogueId = 6103004,
          GUID = "0F473A18",
          NextDialogue = 6103005,

        },
        [6200311] = {
          ContentEN = "By the time she found them, her friends were already unrecognizable remains in the rubble.",
          DialogueId = 6200311,
          GUID = "0F859686",
          NextDialogue = 6200312,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200312] = {
          ContentEN = [[
So she stayed, fighting to the end beside those she once lost.
Was it to protect her fallen friends, to atone for "abandoning" them, or simply to uphold your knightly vows?
Had the endless darkness finally crushed her last hope, leaving her to beg for death's mercy?]],
          DialogueId = 6200312,
          GUID = "0F8596B0",
          NextDialogue = 6200313,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200313] = {
          ContentEN = "Silence is all that remains.",
          DialogueId = 6200313,
          GUID = "0F8596DA",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200401] = {
          ContentEN = "Youthful chatter carries through the gloom — a sound you haven't heard in the abyss for ages. Vibrant. Alive. Untainted by the creeping darkness.
You know with absolute certainty these aren't souls or illusions, but living, breathing humans.",
          DialogueId = 6200401,
          GUID = "0F85A54A",
          NextDialogue = 6200402,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200402] = {
          ContentEN = "You recognize them.",
          DialogueId = 6200402,
          GUID = "0F85A574",
          NextDialogue = 6200403,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200403] = {
          ContentEN = "Following the sound, you push forward as the mist begins to part — revealing those four young Knights standing before you.
Their armors are still unstained by time or battle. The sacred fleur-de-lis emblem on their clothes gleams like captured sunlight, defying the abyss with its radiance.",
          DialogueId = 6200403,
          GUID = "0F85A59E",
          NextDialogue = 6200404,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200404] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Are you sure this is the right way, Captain?"
The blonde Knight bounds up the ancient staircase and leaps back down in one fluid motion.
"It's just another pile of rubble."]],
          DialogueId = 6200404,
          GUID = "0F85A5C8",
          NextDialogue = 6200405,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char01"
        },
        [6200405] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"At least I know we haven't been here before."
The young captain strides past her with measured steps.
"Navigating the Sacred Lake is impossible. We'll just have to take it step by step."]],
          DialogueId = 6200405,
          GUID = "0F85A5F2",
          NextDialogue = 6200406,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char02"
        },
        [6200406] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"And, don't you ever get tired bouncing around like that, Cathy?"
The young captain sighs as he watches his hyperactive teammate.
"Save your energy. This place is dangerous. Let's not take unnecessary risks."]],
          DialogueId = 6200406,
          GUID = "0F85A61C",
          NextDialogue = 6200407,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char02"
        },
        [6200407] = {
          ContentEN = ""I have lots of energy to spare! You're the one who—"",
          DialogueId = 6200407,
          GUID = "0F85A646",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200408
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char01"
        },
        [6200408] = {
          ContentEN = "He's got a point.",
          DialogueId = 6200408,
          GUID = "0F85A670",
          NextDialogue = 6200409,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200409] = {
          ContentEN = "The girl stops mid-sentence, turning to you with wide eyes.",
          DialogueId = 6200409,
          GUID = "0F85A69A",
          NextDialogue = 6200410,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200410] = {
          ContentEN = ""You are…?"",
          DialogueId = 6200410,
          GUID = "0F85A6C4",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200411
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char01"
        },
        [6200411] = {
          ContentEN = "A traveler. I've been here longer than you have. Trust me—this place is far more dangerous than you think.",
          DialogueId = 6200411,
          GUID = "0F85A6EE",
          NextDialogue = 6200412,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200412] = {
          ContentEN = ""A traveler…?" The young Knight's expression flickers with familiar confusion, just like last time. "But this is Elysium's sacred ground… How did you get in?"",
          DialogueId = 6200412,
          GUID = "0F85A718",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200413
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char02"
        },
        [6200413] = {
          ContentEN = "I have my reasons — and a purpose to fulfil. Just like you.",
          DialogueId = 6200413,
          GUID = "0F85A742",
          NextDialogue = 6200414,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200414] = {
          ContentEN = ""Hmm…?"",
          DialogueId = 6200414,
          GUID = "0F85A76C",
          NextDialogue = 6200415,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char03"
        },
        [6200415] = {
          ContentEN = "This time, the cloaked Sorceress finally shows a flicker of interest in you.
She lifts her head. You finally see her eyes — dark, doubtful, searching, like bubbles surfacing in shadowed waters.",
          DialogueId = 6200415,
          GUID = "0F85A796",
          NextDialogue = 6200416,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200416] = {
          ContentEN = ""It sounds like you know truths about this abyss — truths we've yet to uncover."",
          DialogueId = 6200416,
          GUID = "0F85A7C0",
          NextDialogue = 6200417,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char03"
        },
        [6200417] = {
          ContentEN = ""Calista…! Only heretics speak such blasphemy! This is sacred ground, our Sacred Lake!"",
          DialogueId = 6200417,
          GUID = "0F85A7EA",
          NextDialogue = 6200418,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char04"
        },
        [6200418] = {
          ContentEN = "Calista ignores his rebuke, her gaze steady on you, waiting for an answer.",
          DialogueId = 6200418,
          GUID = "0F85A814",
          NextDialogue = 6200419,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200419] = {
          ContentEN = "What will you say? What can you say?",
          DialogueId = 6200419,
          GUID = "0F85A83E",
          NextDialogue = 6200420,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200420] = {
          ContentEN = "Tell them to turn back now? You know their faith forbids it.
Faith — such a heavy word. It holds more weight than a stranger's warning or the plea of a face grown unfamiliar.",
          DialogueId = 6200420,
          GUID = "0F85A868",
          NextDialogue = 6200421,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200421] = {
          ContentEN = "For those raised in faith's radiance, unwanted truths burn like staring at the sun — leaving only daylight's cruel tattoo upon the soul.",
          DialogueId = 6200421,
          GUID = "0F85A892",
          NextDialogue = 6200422,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200422] = {
          ContentEN = "You shake your head, avoiding her gaze.",
          DialogueId = 6200422,
          GUID = "0F85A8BC",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200423
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200423] = {
          ContentEN = "It's easy to get lost in the abyss. Stay close to your friends, Cathy.",
          DialogueId = 6200423,
          GUID = "0F85A8E6",
          NextDialogue = 6200424,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200424] = {
          ContentEN = ""Huh? Why single me out?"",
          DialogueId = 6200424,
          GUID = "0F85A910",
          NextDialogue = 6200425,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char01"
        },
        [6200425] = {
          ContentEN = ""Means you should reflect. Even strangers can see you're the most restless one."",
          DialogueId = 6200425,
          GUID = "0F85A93A",
          NextDialogue = 6200426,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char02"
        },
        [6200426] = {
          ContentEN = ""As if! I'd find you all in no time if we got separated." The girl pouts.",
          DialogueId = 6200426,
          GUID = "0F85A964",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200427
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char01"
        },
        [6200427] = {
          ContentEN = "Next time might be too late.",
          DialogueId = 6200427,
          GUID = "0F85A98E",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6200428,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200428] = {
          ContentEN = "Cathy freezes, caught off guard by your grave tone.",
          DialogueId = 6200428,
          GUID = "0F85A9B8",
          NextDialogue = 6200429,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200429] = {
          ContentEN = "Flynn steps forward — a true Knight of Elysium indeed. For a noble knight, piety alone is not enough; prudence too must be his virtue. He understands the delicate balance of curiosity — enough to gather information, yet not so much as to invite calamity. Like when you find a locked door in the sacred hall left slightly ajar, the wisest choice is to pause, turn away, and pretend you never saw it.",
          DialogueId = 6200429,
          GUID = "0F85A9E2",
          NextDialogue = 6200430,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200430] = {
          ContentEN = ""Though we don't know your true identity, you're clearly here for a reason. Forgive us — duty calls us elsewhere." He bows solemnly. "May the God of Full Moon bless your journey."",
          DialogueId = 6200430,
          GUID = "0F85AA0C",
          NextDialogue = 6200431,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryEvent21_Char02"
        },
        [6200431] = {
          ContentEN = "The Knights depart together, leaving only endless mist before you.",
          DialogueId = 6200431,
          GUID = "0F85AA36",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200501] = {
          ContentEN = "Endless battles drain your strength.
The last ember slips through your fingers — direction lost in the void.",
          DialogueId = 6200501,
          GUID = "0F85B5B2",
          NextDialogue = 6200502,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200502] = {
          ContentEN = [[
The lantern falls to the ground, its crystal shattering with a sound like blades cutting through the silent darkness.
Splintered shadows rush toward you from every direction, corroding your flesh and biting at your nerves.]],
          DialogueId = 6200502,
          GUID = "0F85B5DC",
          NextDialogue = 6200503,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200503] = {
          ContentEN = "As your senses merge with the darkness, you stop resisting. It embraces you gently, tending your wounds, and soothing your weariness.",
          DialogueId = 6200503,
          GUID = "0F85B606",
          NextDialogue = 6200504,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200504] = {
          ContentEN = "Perhaps this is meant to be. The darkness whispers to you —
"You've held on long enough."",
          DialogueId = 6200504,
          GUID = "0F85B630",
          NextDialogue = 6200505,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200505] = {
          ContentEN = "Indeed… You've fought hard enough. Cycle after solitary cycle, you battle and struggle, drinking despair like fine wine while drowning in endless pain — yet dawn's light remains beyond reach.",
          DialogueId = 6200505,
          GUID = "0F85B65A",
          NextDialogue = 6200506,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200506] = {
          ContentEN = "Weariness claims you. Let it end here.",
          DialogueId = 6200506,
          GUID = "0F85B684",
          NextDialogue = 6200507,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200507] = {
          ContentEN = "You feel yourself drifting into the dark cradle of sleep — until a distant figure surfaces in your mind. Though its face eludes you, this vague memory cuts through your numbness like a blade, jolting you awake. It churns the sea of your thoughts, stirring relentless tides.",
          DialogueId = 6200507,
          GUID = "0F85B6AE",
          NextDialogue = 6200508,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200508] = {
          ContentEN = "That figure — the one who vowed to conquer the darkness with you, to escape the abyss together, and the architect of your torment.",
          DialogueId = 6200508,
          GUID = "0F85B6D8",
          NextDialogue = 6200509,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200509] = {
          ContentEN = "You still haven't found them. Yes… now you remember.
Don't you dare close your eyes. No matter how sweet the darkness beckons, this is not the ending you seek.
Fight on — for the journey's end, for your promise, for breaking this cursed cycle.",
          DialogueId = 6200509,
          GUID = "0F85B702",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200510
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200510] = {
          ContentEN = "Rotate the dial",
          DialogueId = 6200510,
          GUID = "0F85B72C",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6200511,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200511] = {
          ContentEN = "Again, you turn the lantern's dial back to where the story begins.",
          DialogueId = 6200511,
          GUID = "0F85B756",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200601] = {
          ContentEN = [[
Directions warp constantly in the abyss. You can't always tell if you're moving forward or backward.
Sometimes you feel trapped in an ouroboros spiral, circling without hope of escape.]],
          DialogueId = 6200601,
          GUID = "0F85C61A",
          NextDialogue = 6200602,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200602] = {
          ContentEN = "Yet when this colossal entity appears before you, instinct screams — this is the abyss's "beating heart.",
          DialogueId = 6200602,
          GUID = "0F85C644",
          NextDialogue = 6200603,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200603] = {
          ContentEN = [[
You raise the lantern, but its feeble light drowns the moment it grazes His edges.
The chaotic darkness swirls like ink, converging toward a single point.]],
          DialogueId = 6200603,
          GUID = "0F85C66E",
          NextDialogue = 6200604,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200604] = {
          ContentEN = "The earth shudders and splits, swallowing you whole.
Your body dissolves into the churning dark — limbs scattering like ink in water, pulled toward the devouring heart.",
          DialogueId = 6200604,
          GUID = "0F85C698",
          NextDialogue = 6200605,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200605] = {
          ContentEN = "A deafening silence crushes your skull. Survival instinct screams: Turn back now.",
          DialogueId = 6200605,
          GUID = "0F85C6C2",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200606,
            [2] = 6200615
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200606] = {
          ContentEN = "Don't look away.",
          DialogueId = 6200606,
          GUID = "0F85C6EC",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6200607,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200607] = {
          ContentEN = "You refuse to back down.
Rising from the void, lantern held high — your stance declares what words cannot: this darkness holds no terror for you.",
          DialogueId = 6200607,
          GUID = "0F85C716",
          NextDialogue = 6200608,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200608] = {
          ContentEN = "Gradually, something fractures the darkness — a sliver of fissure appears, slipping something into your veins. Unthinkable, yet you comprehend its whispers.",
          DialogueId = 6200608,
          GUID = "0F85C740",
          NextDialogue = 6200609,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200609] = {
          ContentEN = [[
These are human emotions: doubt, fury, anguish, despair, and crushing sorrow.
A sorrow so overwhelming it feels as if the very abyss itself is longing for an end.]],
          DialogueId = 6200609,
          GUID = "0F85C76A",
          NextDialogue = 6200610,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200610] = {
          ContentEN = "The question burns in your throat: "How can I help you?"",
          DialogueId = 6200610,
          GUID = "0F85C794",
          NextDialogue = 6200611,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200611] = {
          ContentEN = "Keep on. Your lantern's flame still falters in the dark. It says. Your answer awaits at the cycle's end.",
          DialogueId = 6200611,
          GUID = "0F85C7BE",
          NextDialogue = 6200612,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200612] = {
          ContentEN = ""Where does it end?" You ask.",
          DialogueId = 6200612,
          GUID = "0F85C7E8",
          NextDialogue = 6200613,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200613] = {
          ContentEN = "Only silence answers. Darkness cradles you tenderly, until only your lantern's light persists in the void.",
          DialogueId = 6200613,
          GUID = "0F85C812",
          NextDialogue = 6200614,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200614] = {
          ContentEN = "So you turn the dial on the lantern, rewinding time once more.",
          DialogueId = 6200614,
          GUID = "0F85C83C",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200615] = {
          ContentEN = "Turn back",
          DialogueId = 6200615,
          GUID = "0F85C866",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6200616,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200616] = {
          ContentEN = [[
A wise choice.
Turn back. Step away. Instinct screams for retreat though you know you can never retrace your footsteps.]],
          DialogueId = 6200616,
          GUID = "0F85C890",
          NextDialogue = 6200617,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200617] = {
          ContentEN = "Out of nowhere, a presence prickles between your shoulder blades — silent, watching, aching with the weight of your departure.",
          DialogueId = 6200617,
          GUID = "0F85C8BA",
          NextDialogue = 6200618,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200618] = {
          ContentEN = "Do you want me to turn back?" Your heart whispers the question into the dark.",
          DialogueId = 6200618,
          GUID = "0F85C8E4",
          NextDialogue = 6200619,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200619] = {
          ContentEN = "No. Walk your path, It speaks. At the cycle's end, we'll meet again.",
          DialogueId = 6200619,
          GUID = "0F85C90E",
          NextDialogue = 6200620,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200620] = {
          ContentEN = "Where does it end?" You ask.",
          DialogueId = 6200620,
          GUID = "0F85C938",
          NextDialogue = 6200621,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200621] = {
          ContentEN = "Only silence answers. Darkness flows over your shoulder, gently saturating the space around you, until only your lantern's light persists in the void.",
          DialogueId = 6200621,
          GUID = "0F85C962",
          NextDialogue = 6200622,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200622] = {
          ContentEN = "So you turn the dial on the lantern, rewinding time once more.",
          DialogueId = 6200622,
          GUID = "0F85C98C",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200701] = {
          ContentEN = "A mysterious young man stands by the campfire. In truth, you cannot be sure of his age — you only guess from the sound of his voice.
This is not your first encounter.",
          DialogueId = 6200701,
          GUID = "0F85D682",
          NextDialogue = 6200702,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200702] = {
          ContentEN = ""We meet again, brave traveller."",
          DialogueId = 6200702,
          GUID = "0F85D6AC",
          NextDialogue = 6200703,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_StoryShop_Char01"
        },
        [6200703] = {
          ContentEN = "He greets you with quiet courtesy.
You cannot see his eyes — a sharp-edged mask of metal covers his face from brow to cheek.",
          DialogueId = 6200703,
          GUID = "0F85D6D6",
          NextDialogue = 6200704,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200704] = {
          ContentEN = ""Those who wander the Abyss for too long often lose their way — until, at last, they become one of the Abyssoids."
"But the <H>light</> within these objects will guide you, lest your path be swallowed by the darkness," he says. "Place them within your Lantern, as its Lampwick."
Where his eyes should be, the firelight shimmers faintly, caught in the steel.",
          DialogueId = 6200704,
          GUID = "0F85D700",
          NextDialogue = 6200705,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_StoryShop_Char01"
        },
        [6200705] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"But I do not think you ever truly forget. For you are <H>always</> fated to return here."
"As always, I have laid out supplies by the campfire. Take what you need, whenever the need arises."]],
          DialogueId = 6200705,
          GUID = "0F85D72A",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200706
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_StoryShop_Char01"
        },
        [6200706] = {
          ContentEN = "Who are you?",
          DialogueId = 6200706,
          GUID = "0F85D754",
          NextDialogue = 6200707,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200707] = {
          ContentEN = ""That question again. You've asked it many times. Forgive me — I cannot answer, not now."
"Not because I would hide the truth... but because I, too, am unsure — here and now — what name I ought to claim."
He lets out a soft laugh.",
          DialogueId = 6200707,
          GUID = "0F85D77E",
          NextDialogue = 6200708,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_StoryShop_Char01"
        },
        [6200708] = {
          ContentEN = ""Then let us keep it simple — think of me as a humble <H>merchant</>."
"Just as you so often say of yourself: 'I am but a humble traveller.'"",
          DialogueId = 6200708,
          GUID = "0F85D7A8",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6200709
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_StoryShop_Char01"
        },
        [6200709] = {
          ContentEN = "I must be on my way.",
          DialogueId = 6200709,
          GUID = "0F85D7D2",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6200710,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6200710] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Farewell, brave traveller," he says. "May the flame of your Lantern shine ever unceasing upon your path."
You still cannot see his face. Perhaps, behind the mask, the firelight flickers in his eyes.]],
          DialogueId = 6200710,
          GUID = "0F85D7FC",
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "RougeLike_StoryShop_Char01"
        },
        [6200801] = {
          ContentEN = "The Abyssal Merchant stands beside the fire — just as he always has.
No howls of Abyssoids; only silence enfolds this place.",
          DialogueId = 6200801,
          GUID = "0F85E6EA",
          NextDialogue = 6200802,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6200802] = {
          ContentEN = [[

        [6201623] = {

        [6201624] = {

          DialogueId = 6201624,

          NextDialogue = 6201625,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201625] = {
          ContentEN = "Now that we're safe? We carry on, of course! But first — Flynn needs some patching up.",
          DialogueId = 6201625,
          GUID = "0F866E1A",
          NextDialogue = 6201626,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Kathy"
        },
        [6201626] = {
          ContentEN = "She catches the worry in your eyes, and answers it with a bright smile.",
          DialogueId = 6201626,
          GUID = "0F866E44",
          NextDialogue = 6201627,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201627] = {
          ContentEN = "Traveller — do you remember the question Flynn asked you last time we met? I think I finally understand." Her tone is calm, resolute. "The Abyss will not be defeated by one battle, nor by some mighty hero. It will be defeated by all of us — by our efforts, joined together. Even the smallest step forward is our share toward that final victory.",
          DialogueId = 6201627,
          GUID = "0F866E6E",
          NextDialogue = 6201628,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Kathy"
        },
        [6201628] = {
          ContentEN = "Heh... Kathy. Never thought I'd hear something so wise from you. Makes me seem a poor captain beside you."
At last, Flynn regains his senses. With her support, he rises — and straightens his back.
"The Abyss spreads with every moment. If left unchecked, it will consume all of Elysium. Even if we can only delay it, we must fight to the end. Besides... we still haven't found Dame Lisbell.",
          DialogueId = 6201628,
          GUID = "0F866E98",
          NextDialogue = 6201629,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Flynn"
        },
        [6201629] = {
          ContentEN = "Right! We've still got to bring her home. So, Traveller — walk your path. Don't worry about us. Do not bear our burden. Only carry our blessing with you."
She presses her hand over her heart, meeting your eyes,
and speaks with solemn sincerity:
"<H>May the Goddess of Fate bathe you in a thousand beams of moonlight, and may your wings shine for ever, flawless as the full moon.</>",
          DialogueId = 6201629,
          GUID = "0F866EC2",
          NextDialogue = 6201630,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Kathy"
        },
        [6201630] = {
          ContentEN = [[
It is a blessing most solemn. In Elysium, such words are given only to one you may never see again.
Yet it is no farewell of despair. It is calm acceptance of fate.
"I wish you safe passage on the road ahead... and accept that it may mean we are parted, in life or in death, forevermore."]],
          DialogueId = 6201630,
          GUID = "0F866EEC",
          NextDialogue = 6201631,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201631] = {
          ContentEN = "You give Kathy a silent nod. Raising your Lantern, you step once more onto the path before you.",
          DialogueId = 6201631,
          GUID = "0F866F16",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201701] = {
          ContentEN = "The voices of young men and women drift through the Abyss. It has been so long since you last heard such sounds here — lively, vibrant, untouched by darkness.
And you know: these are no phantoms, no echoes of the dead, but living human beings.",
          DialogueId = 6201701,
          GUID = "0F867A92",
          NextDialogue = 6201702,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201702] = {
          ContentEN = "Once more, you cross paths with them.",
          DialogueId = 6201702,
          GUID = "0F867ABC",
          NextDialogue = 6201703,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201703] = {
          ContentEN = "As before, the four young Knights emerge together from the mist.
Yet their blood-stained figures linger sharp in your memory. For a moment, you cannot tell which is crueller — for them, doomed to die in despair time after time... or for you, condemned to watch them die again and again.",
          DialogueId = 6201703,
          GUID = "0F867AE6",
          NextDialogue = 6201704,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201704] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6201704,
          GUID = "0F867B10",
          NextDialogue = 6201705,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Kathy"
        },
        [6201705] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"At least I know we haven't been here before."

"Navigating the Sacred Lake is impossible. We'll just have to take it step by step."]],
          DialogueId = 6201705,
          GUID = "0F867B3A",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6201706,
            [2] = 6201716
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Flynn"
        },
        [6201706] = {
          ContentEN = "Turn back... while you still can.",

          GUID = "0F867B64",

          NextDialogue = 6201707,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201707] = {

          DialogueId = 6201707,

          NextDialogue = 6201708,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Flynn"
        },
        [6201708] = {
          ContentEN = "You're friends of Lisbell, right? She asked me to warn you: the Abyss is far more perilous than you imagine. No single squad can withstand it. Go back — do not throw your lives away."

          DialogueId = 6201708,
          GUID = "0F867BB8",
          NextDialogue = 6201709,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201709] = {

          NextDialogue = 6201710,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Kathy"
        },
        [6201710] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6201710,
          GUID = "0F867C0C",
          NextDialogue = 6201711,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201711] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6201711,
          GUID = "0F867C36",
          NextDialogue = 6201712,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201712] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"You tell us to turn back..."

"But really... it wouldn't make a difference, would it?"]],
          DialogueId = 6201712,
          GUID = "0F867C60",
          NextDialogue = 6201713,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201713] = {
          ContentEN = "It is a question you cannot answer.

          DialogueId = 6201713,
          GUID = "0F867C8A",
          NextDialogue = 6201714,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201714] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"My friends..."

"<H>May the Goddess of Fate bathe you in a thousand beams of moonlight, and may your wings shine for ever, flawless as the full moon.</>"]],
          DialogueId = 6201714,
          GUID = "0F867CB4",
          NextDialogue = 6201715,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201715] = {
          ContentEN = "At your words of blessing, a faint, sorrowful smile touches Calista's lips. And in that moment you realise: perhaps what she truly wished... was for you to contradict her. Even with a lie.",
          DialogueId = 6201715,
          GUID = "0F867CDE",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201716] = {
          ContentEN = "Brave Knights, may the Goddess of the Full Moon watch over your journey.",
          DialogueId = 6201716,
          GUID = "0F867D08",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6201717,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201717] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Hm?"
Your sudden blessing leaves the young man bewildered.
"And you are...?"]],
          DialogueId = 6201717,
          GUID = "0F867D32",
          NextDialogue = 6201718,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Flynn"
        },
        [6201718] = {
          ContentEN = "You're friends of Lisbell, right? She asked me to warn you: the Abyss is far more perilous than you imagine. You will face trials beyond anything you know. Be prepared.",
          DialogueId = 6201718,
          GUID = "0F867D5C",
          NextDialogue = 6201719,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201719] = {
          ContentEN = "Really!? You know Dame Lisbell? Is she safe? Where is she?",
          DialogueId = 6201719,
          GUID = "0F867D86",
          NextDialogue = 6201720,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Kathy"
        },
        [6201720] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Hold on, Kathy. It's not wise to trust someone we've just met."
The Priest draws her back, his eyes narrowing with suspicion.
"Dame Lisbell is not of such a sober temperament. I can scarcely imagine her speaking with such gravity. Besides, this campaign was decreed by His Holiness the Pope himself. We will do our utmost. We need no further reminder."]],
          DialogueId = 6201720,
          GUID = "0F867DB0",
          NextDialogue = 6201721,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201721] = {
          ContentEN = "I, for one, believe this traveller speaks truth. Dwell in this place long enough, and even madness itself begins to seem ordinary — what is a shift in temperament compared to that?"
The Sorceress lifts her head, fixing her deep eyes upon you as though to unravel a riddle.
"Who are you, truly? I cannot shake the feeling... that I have seen you before.",
          DialogueId = 6201721,
          GUID = "0F867DDA",
          NextDialogue = 6201722,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201722] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"...My name doesn't matter."
You look upon the young Knights and offer an earnest smile.
"All you need to know is that my blessing is sincere. Even if the end has already been written... I pray you may still find meaning in the journey."]],
          DialogueId = 6201722,
          GUID = "0F867E04",
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201801] = {
          ContentEN = "From a distance, you glimpse two familiar figures hemmed in by a horde of Abyssoids — Milton and Calista.
They fight in perfect accord, cutting through wave after wave, yet still the tide does not relent.
You lift your Lantern and advance. At the Glazeystal's radiant glow, the Abyssoids recoil — if only for a moment.",
          DialogueId = 6201801,
          GUID = "0F868AFA",
          NextDialogue = 6201802,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201802] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"You... you are the one from before."
The Priest startles, then drops his gaze in quiet shame.
"I spoke harshly before, yet still you came to our aid. I pray you, accept both my apology and my gratitude, mysterious traveller."]],
          DialogueId = 6201802,
          GUID = "0F868B24",
          NextDialogue = 6201803,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201803] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"So it's true... you're no ordinary soul. My thanks."
The Sorceress lowers her hood in greeting, the same jet-black hair tumbling free.
"That lantern you carry... is it some holy relic? By what power does it drive the Abyssoids away?"]],
          DialogueId = 6201803,
          GUID = "0F868B4E",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6201804
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201804] = {
          ContentEN = "Someone entrusted it to me.",
          DialogueId = 6201804,
          GUID = "0F868B78",
          NextDialogue = 6201805,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201805] = {
          ContentEN = "If that is so, I shall not pry. Yet with such a lantern, our way through the Abyss would be far lighter. Might we walk at your side?",
          DialogueId = 6201805,
          GUID = "0F868BA2",
          NextDialogue = 6201806,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201806] = {
          ContentEN = "I don't mind. But know this — my path is not yours. I'm only here to restore the lantern, gathering shards of Glazeystal.",
          DialogueId = 6201806,
          GUID = "0F868BCC",
          NextDialogue = 6201807,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201807] = {
          ContentEN = "At this point, our mission scarcely matters... Yet something tells me that with you, we stand a better chance of uncovering the truth of the Abyss.",
          DialogueId = 6201807,
          GUID = "0F868BF6",
          NextDialogue = 6201808,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201808] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"What nonsense is that, Calista?" 
Before you can reply, the Priest cuts in sharply.
"Though parted from the others, we are still Knights of Elysium. Even if but one remains, our duty endures!"]],
          DialogueId = 6201808,
          GUID = "0F868C20",
          NextDialogue = 6201809,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201809] = {
          ContentEN = "Heh... duty. Is your head filled with nothing but hollow oaths?"
The Sorceress's voice flares, quiver rattling with each sharp movement.
"Look at what we have faced here — Filthoids, Phantasms, wandering shades and spirits. If those above are right, and the Sacred Lake really leads to the Heaven above Heavens... then what are these Abyssoids we must cut down? Does this not resemble more a demon's den, as the Noclunism once—"",
          DialogueId = 6201809,
          GUID = "0F868C4A",
          NextDialogue = 6201810,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201810] = {
          ContentEN = ""Y—You are mad! You speak like a heretic!"
He clings to his composure, yet a faint hesitation threads his voice.
"Those Abyssoids... perhaps their faith faltered, and they failed the last trial. If we sweep aside these obstacles, the Sacred Lake may yet be restored. Perhaps this is the trial ordained by the Great Nine Themselves — and if we remain steadfast, their protection shall shield us from harm..."",
          DialogueId = 6201810,
          GUID = "0F868C74",
          NextDialogue = 6201811,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201811] = {
          ContentEN = ""If your gods truly cared, they'd descend themselves to cleanse this hell."
A bitter laugh breaks from her, fading into a weary sigh.
"Perhaps we were sent only to die. The purge was never the point — what mattered was sacrifice upon sacrifice, to sate the Abyss. Many of the Abyssoids we have faced... were Knights sent before us."",
          DialogueId = 6201811,
          GUID = "0F868C9E",
          NextDialogue = 6201812,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201812] = {
          ContentEN = ""They were veterans — older, stronger, wiser, tempered by countless wars. Yet they too fell, and now they haunt us as Abyssoids. There is no escape. Madness or death awaits us all — sooner or later."",
          DialogueId = 6201812,
          GUID = "0F868CC8",
          NextDialogue = 6201813,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201813] = {
          ContentEN = [[
The Priest's lips press tight, his face drawn. He grips his staff to mask the tremor in his hands.
At length, he speaks again, his voice outwardly composed.
"...Given the circumstances, I shall pretend I never heard those words. Flynn is absent, and by rank the command falls to me. I order you: cease your slander of the Doctrine and the Saints, and fulfil your duty as a Knight."]],
          DialogueId = 6201813,
          GUID = "0F868CF2",
          NextDialogue = 6201814,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201814] = {
          ContentEN = ""...Very well. Dying sooner is no ill fate."
She bows her head and draws her hood once more, as though yielding to her fate.
"Even so... as your friend, I must ask — if your faith rests upon falsehoods, is it truly worth dying for?"",
          DialogueId = 6201814,
          GUID = "0F868D1C",
          NextDialogue = 6201815,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201815] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"..." 
The Priest gives no answer, only shakes his head in silence. At last he steps forward and bows to you. 
"Forgive our unseemly quarrel. We are resolved now. Once we have taken our rest, we shall continue onward. Farewell, kind traveller. May the Goddess of the Full Moon watch over your journey."]],
          DialogueId = 6201815,
          GUID = "0F868D46",
          NextOptions = {
            [1] = 6201816,
            [2] = 6201818,
            [3] = 6201820
          },
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201816] = {
          ContentEN = "May the Goddess of the Full Moon watch over yours as well.",
          DialogueId = 6201816,
          GUID = "0F868D70",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6201817,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201817] = {
          ContentEN = [[
At your words, Milton smiles faintly, as though at peace. Calista turns aside in silence, her face hidden.
With a final nod, you turn and walk away.]],
          DialogueId = 6201817,
          GUID = "0F868D9A",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201818] = {
          ContentEN = "I fear the Goddess of the Full Moon has little aid left for me.",
          DialogueId = 6201818,
          GUID = "0F868DC4",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6201819,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201819] = {
          ContentEN = [[
At your words, Milton averts his eyes, clearly uneasy, but remains silent. Calista gives a sorrowful smile, then lowers her head in weary resignation.
With a final nod, you turn and walk away.]],
          DialogueId = 6201819,
          GUID = "0F868DEE",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201820] = {
          ContentEN = "I think... perhaps what truly matters is not faith, but courage.",
          DialogueId = 6201820,
          GUID = "0F868E18",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6201821,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6201821] = {
          ContentEN = "At your words, Milton and Calista trade a surprised glance, then sink into thoughtful silence.
You add nothing more — for the words were not your own, and even now their meaning eludes you.
With a final nod, you turn and walk away.",
          DialogueId = 6201821,
          GUID = "0F868E42",
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201901] = {
          ContentEN = "A sharp, ominous tang of blood drifts from ahead.

          DialogueId = 6201901,
          GUID = "0F869B62",
          NextDialogue = 6201902,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201902] = {
          ContentEN = "Suddenly, pale gleams break across the dark — no, not light. You peer closer, and see them for what they are: the bleached husks of Filthoids, piled one upon another, as if some heretic painter had hurled his strokes in a drunken frenzy.
You flinch back — and two familiar figures take shape beside you.",
          DialogueId = 6201902,
          GUID = "0F869B8C",
          NextDialogue = 6201903,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201903] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Cough... cough... This just never ends..."
The Sorceress wipes the blood from her lips, her longbow slipping from her grasp.
"That was my last arrow. It's magic or nothing now. Ha... that should count as devotion to your gods. Just don't throw me into some mass grave. Let my body at least remain whole."]],
          DialogueId = 6201903,
          GUID = "0F869BB6",
          NextDialogue = 6201904,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201904] = {
          ContentEN = ""Don't say that — look out!"
The Priest lashes his staff through the dark, its tip bursting with light.
"Tch... more Abyssoids..."",
          DialogueId = 6201904,
          GUID = "0F869BE0",
          NextDialogue = 6201905,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201905] = {
          ContentEN = "You wheel around with Calista, watching them surge forward, rolling over the shattered Filthoid husks like another stroke of ruin across a grotesque canvas.
You raise your Lantern in haste — but it does nothing. And then you see it: the Lantern's glow passes straight through Milton's staff.",
          DialogueId = 6201905,
          GUID = "0F869C0A",
          NextDialogue = 6201906,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201906] = {
          ContentEN = "And it strikes you — this is no reality, but the echo of a memory. You stand at their side, yet powerless, forced only to watch as they bleed, falter, and fall.",
          DialogueId = 6201906,
          GUID = "0F869C34",
          NextDialogue = 6201907,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201907] = {
          ContentEN = "The Abyssoids dwindle. Four remain... then three... two... one. If either Knight had a breath of strength left.
If their comrades had reached them in time. If a single shard of Glazeystal had lain close at hand... They might have won. They might have lived.
But no. Nothing. All that remains is you — the bystander who came too late.",
          DialogueId = 6201907,
          GUID = "0F869C5E",
          NextDialogue = 6201908,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201908] = {
          ContentEN = "A human-shaped Abyssoid lurches near — once their senior, comrade, perhaps even friend. His black spear thrusts straight for Calista's heart.
You shut your eyes, unwilling to see.",
          DialogueId = 6201908,
          GUID = "0F869C88",
          NextDialogue = 6201909,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201909] = {

        [6201910] = {

          NextDialogue = 6201911,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6201911] = {
          ContentEN = ""What... what have you done...? You..."

"Did you not call me a heretic...? Then why... why waste your life on me? Weren't you so bent on proving your faith? Then why cast your life away like this?"",

          GUID = "0F869D06",
          NextDialogue = 6201912,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201912] = {
          ContentEN = ""Because my faith taught me... to protect my comrades. Doubt it if you must... but of this I am certain."

"I have given the gods enough already... so let me speak once for myself. Calista... cast aside the oaths, the duty. Leave this place. Live."",
          DialogueId = 6201912,
          GUID = "0F869D30",
          NextDialogue = 6201913,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201913] = {
          ContentEN = ""What...?"",
          DialogueId = 6201913,
          GUID = "0F869D5A",
          NextDialogue = 6201914,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201914] = {
          ContentEN = ""Once I am gone, you will be your own commander. Free to act as you will. As you always said... run. Escape the Abyss. Or seek out that traveller. Whatever it takes — live."",
          DialogueId = 6201914,
          GUID = "0F869D84",
          NextDialogue = 6201915,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201915] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6201915,
          GUID = "0F869DAE",
          NextDialogue = 6201916,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6201916] = {
          ContentEN = ""You're speaking nonsense again..."
With trembling fingers — the same hand that once gripped his staff with unyielding strength — he unfastens the insignia from his chest and presses it into her palm.
"You were always the best among us. From the day we entered this place, you were the first to see the truth, the first to question it with courage. You... can endure. I believe in you..."",

          GUID = "0F869DD8",
          NextDialogue = 6201917,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Milton"
        },
        [6201917] = {
          ContentEN = "The Phantasms fade before Calista can answer.

          DialogueId = 6201917,
          GUID = "0F869E02",
          NextOptions = {

        [6202002] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6202002,

        },
        [6202003] = {
          ContentEN = [[

        },
        [6202004] = {
          ContentEN = "I have faced It many times, across countless cycles.",
          DialogueId = 6202004,
