          NextDialogue = 6202005,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6202005] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Cycles?"
Her eyes kindle with sudden light, like a scholar grasping a riddle at last.
"Ah... I see. Now it all makes sense. No wonder your eyes looked on us with such... mercy. You have watched our end, again and again... haven't you? Then soon, I shall be with them once more. If that is true... death no longer seems so frightening."]],
          DialogueId = 6202005,
          GUID = "0F86AC72",
          NextDialogue = 6202008,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6202006] = {
          ContentEN = "Ignorance is bliss.",
          DialogueId = 6202006,
          GUID = "0F86AC9C",
          IsKeyOption = true,
          NextDialogue = 6202007,
          RougeTalkActorType = 2,
          SpeakNpcId = 910004
        },
        [6202007] = {
          ContentEN = ""Heh... you are right. I cannot fathom what you have endured, to bear a calm so... dreadful, and so strong."
Her dark eyes linger on you — gentle, peaceful, like an old friend at parting.
"I always felt... you were holding something back. But I believe you had your reasons, just as they had their faith."",
          DialogueId = 6202007,
          GUID = "0F86ACC6",
          NextDialogue = 6202008,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6202008] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Please... take this. Carry it with you, if you can. It is my final request..."
With a trembling hand she presses a worn notebook into yours.
"Milton told me to run... but I know I will not make it back. So at the very least... let this life leave behind some worth."]],
          DialogueId = 6202008,
          GUID = "0F86ACF0",
          NextDialogue = 6202009,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6202009] = {
          ContentEN = ""In this Abyss... I spent so long questioning which faith was true. The Goddess of the Full Moon, or the Goddess of the Dark Moon — who was real? I never found the answer, and quarrelled with my friends over it again and again."
She sighs, half in self-mockery.
"Only now do I see: the truth of faith itself matters little. What matters is what its believers do. My friends proved their faith through action — and I believe they did the right thing. So in the end, I choose to give you my blessing... in the name of their faith, true or not."",
          DialogueId = 6202009,
          GUID = "0F86AD1A",
          NextDialogue = 6202010,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6202010] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"Then... Traveller..."
Her trembling pale hand presses to her chest. Eyes glazed with fading light, she struggles to hold your form in view.
"<H>May the Goddess of Fate bathe you in a thousand beams of moonlight, and may your wings shine for ever, flawless as the full moon.</>"]],
          DialogueId = 6202010,
          GUID = "0F86AD44",
          NextDialogue = 6202011,
          RougeTalkActorType = 1,
          SpeakNpcName = "StoryNPC_Calista"
        },
        [6202011] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6202011,
          GUID = "0F86AD6E",
          NextDialogue = 6202012,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202012] = {
          ContentEN = [[
You unfold the notebook she placed in your hands. Though smudged with blood and dirt, the writing is still legible.
"I, Calista of the 'Hushed Dusk' squad of the Wingfeather Order under the Elysian Church, set down here what I have observed concerning the Sacred Lake. Should someone find this notebook, may these notes lend the smallest aid to your journey."]],
          DialogueId = 6202012,
          GUID = "0F86AD98",
          NextDialogue = 6202013,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202013] = {
          ContentEN = "By lantern-light you skim the pages. Hasty scrawls, likely scratched in the dark, chart Abyssoids and Phantasms — their weaknesses, the means to drive them away. 
One page arrests your gaze.
"It is certain now: the scriptures of the <H>Noclunism</> are not wholly false... The Sacred Lake has no tie to the Heaven above Heavens. The so-called 'summoning' is closer to sacrifice. This place brims with the malice of the dead — a vessel of their lingering spite."
"My family were devotees of the Noclunism. They worshipped the Abyss and the Goddess of the Dark Moon, and believed that one of the Seven Virtues, <H>Shaliel</>, never ascended to the Heaven above Heavens, but became instead the <H>Demon King</> beneath the lake — the very heart of the Abyss. He devours souls, offering them to Nepha."",
          DialogueId = 6202013,
          GUID = "0F86ADC2",
          NextDialogue = 6202014,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202014] = {
          ContentEN = [[
"In past years I clung to the Orthodoxy, refusing to believe such horrors. Yet the Abyss questions me at every turn: what if the Noclunism's scriptures were true...? What if our world's end is truly darkness and nothingness?"
"Then... could the Abyss truly be invincible?"
"Alas, this frail body will not endure long enough to learn the answer."]],
          DialogueId = 6202014,
          GUID = "0F86ADEC",
          NextDialogue = 6202015,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202015] = {
          ContentEN = [[
Milton once told me about a <H>Holy Sword</> <H>named Koranu</>, shattered here at the Sacred Lake by accident long ago. It was a relic of the Church, said to bear immense power... And I once saw a traveller whose lantern could drive back the Abyssoids."
"If anything can defeat the Abyss... it may be those two."]],
          DialogueId = 6202015,
          GUID = "0F86AE16",
          NextDialogue = 6202016,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202016] = {
          ContentEN = [[

          DialogueId = 6202016,
          GUID = "0F86AE40",
          NextDialogue = 6202017,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3

        [6202017] = {

          RougeTalkActorType = 3

        [6202018] = {
          ContentEN = "For a fleeting moment, her words carry you elsewhere, far from the Abyss — to the Elysian Knights' camp.

          DialogueId = 6202018,
          GUID = "0F86AE94",
          NextDialogue = 6202019,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202019] = {
          ContentEN = "They trained together:
"'You four are practically a squad,' the instructor always said. So Flynn took it seriously and insisted we choose a squad name. Kathy, of course, chimed in — those two were always fooling around. But I never thought Milton would humour them. Does he secretly nurse some kind of hero complex?"
"'Hushed Dusk' versus 'Valiant Potatoes' — Flynn's and Kathy's suggestions. Milton and I chose the first without hesitation. Considering the day's lunch was potato stew, I suspect Kathy coined hers on the spot."
"As for Flynn's 'Dusk'... outsiders might not see it, but we all knew it was a secret homage to his beloved Moonrise Knight."",
          DialogueId = 6202019,
          GUID = "0F86AEBE",
          NextDialogue = 6202020,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202020] = {
          ContentEN = "They fought together:
"On marches, Kathy would always vanish. At first we panicked, but she always turned up again in the strangest places, giving us a fright. In time, we grew used to it. Still... how does she manage it? She's hardly the type to master teleportation magic..."
"Milton, that hopeless bookworm, actually carried books onto the battlefield, claiming he'd read in spare moments. Unbelievable..."
"Later, one of the Empire's fire arrows burned the lot to ash. He sulked for an entire day. Honestly, he should have thanked that soldier — his pack was at least two-thirds lighter afterwards."",
          DialogueId = 6202020,
          GUID = "0F86AEE8",
          NextDialogue = 6202021,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202021] = {
          ContentEN = "They undertook the mission together:
"To avoid arguments, I never told my parents I'd signed up for the Abyss expedition — only my brother. But even he scolded me, calling it a Church plot, swearing the Demon King would make sacrifices of us... Ugh. All that nagging was exhausting."
"Truthfully, I never cared about fighting the Abyss. But Flynn was so eager, I couldn't turn him down. In our past battles we were never at the front — we lost more often than we won. He must have longed for a chance to prove himself... So I signed up too — just to help him chase that dream of being a true Knight. As long as we stick together, it doesn't matter where we go."",
          DialogueId = 6202021,
          GUID = "0F86AF12",
          NextDialogue = 6202022,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202022] = {
          ContentEN = "...",
          DialogueId = 6202022,
          GUID = "0F86AF3C",
          NextDialogue = 6202023,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202023] = {
          ContentEN = "You reach the final page.",
          DialogueId = 6202023,
          GUID = "0F86AF66",
          NextDialogue = 6202024,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202024] = {
          ContentEN = ""O silent gods — if, as Milton believed, Your gaze is truly upon us... then I beg You: grant me one last mercy."

          GUID = "0F86AF90",
          NextDialogue = 6202025,
          RougeTalkActorType = 3
        },
        [6202025] = {
          ContentEN = "<H>"My wings no longer need the radiance of the full moon. I ask only for a soft wind, to bear me home — to where they wait."</>",

          RougeTalkActorType = 3
